text: dsh-wsl-workspace-picker 是面向 DSH 网页端的工作区目录选择器扩展，通过客户端界面的目录流程插槽替换侧边栏和会话首页的默认选择窗口。它提供主目录、文件系统根目录及已挂载目录的快捷入口，支持输入绝对路径、从根目录逐级浏览面包屑、创建文件夹和切换隐藏目录显示。目录读取与创建调用 DSH 工作区服务，界面提供中英文文案。适合在 WSL、macOS 或 Linux 挂载目录中快速选择项目工作区；安装到 web profile 后即可使用，不需要额外密钥。

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker replaces the DSH web workspace dialogs with a browser for mounted folders. It offers Home and mount shortcuts, absolute path entry, root-level breadcrumbs, folder creation, and a hidden-folder toggle. It uses DSH workspace services and needs no extra key.
想在 DSH 网页端更方便地浏览工作区目录。
能否直接从文件系统根目录一路点进项目文件夹？
我希望在工作区选择窗口里输入绝对路径跳转。
怎样快速打开 WSL 的 /mnt/c 或 /mnt/d 目录？
想从目录选择器里创建一个新的工作文件夹。
DSH 选工作区时找不到挂载盘，有没有快捷入口？
I want to browse mounted folders when choosing a DSH workspace.
Can I jump to a project directory by entering its absolute path?
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker 的功能「quick-access」：快捷访问主目录、根目录和实际检测到的挂载点；选择窗口打开时探测 /mnt 与 /Volumes，将可用挂载位置显示为快捷按钮。
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker 的功能「path-navigation」：在常显路径框中输入绝对路径并按回车跳转，也可点击从文件系统根目录开始的面包屑逐级导航。
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker 的功能「folder-creation」：在当前目录打开新建文件夹对话框，输入名称后创建；成功后自动进入新目录，失败时显示错误信息。
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker 的功能「hidden-folders」：切换是否显示隐藏目录，并在确认当前目录后将它作为 DSH 工作区打开。

Enhanced workspace-directory browser for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI: quick access to `/mnt` Windows drives, full breadcrumb ancestry from the filesystem root, and an always-visible path input.

| [中文说明](README.zh.md) |

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Screenshot：The enhanced "Select Workspace Directory" dialog: quick-access chips for `/mnt` Windows drives at the top, the always-visible path input, and full breadcrumbs from `/`.

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Why：The stock in-app directory picker (the dialog behind the sidebar workspaces "+" button and the conversation-hero workspace picker) starts at the Linux home directory and **folds its breadcrumbs at home**. Under WSL, Windows drives live at `/mnt/c`, `/mnt/d`, … — reachable only by typing a path into a barely visible pencil-glyph editor that most users never find, and never clickable through the breadcrumbs at all.
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Why：This plugin shadows the stock dialog with a single-pane browser that makes every path reachable:

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Why：- **Quick-access chips** — Home, `/`, and every mount point discovered on the host: the Windows drives under `/mnt` (WSL) or the volumes under `/Volumes` (macOS), one click each.
- **An always-visible path input** — type any absolute path (e.g. `/mnt/d/projects`) and press Enter.
- **Full breadcrumb ancestry from `/`** — click up and down through the whole filesystem; no more home-folding dead end.
- **New-folder creation** and a **hidden-files toggle**, like the stock dialog.

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wsl-workspace-picker
```

Restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser page. Open the workspace picker via the sidebar workspaces "+" button (or the conversation-hero workspace picker) — the enhanced dialog appears in place of the stock one.

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-wsl-workspace-picker
```

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · How it works：The browser half of this dual-face package registers into both `directoryFlow` slots (`sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` and `conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow`) at slot priority **−10**. DSH's slot system is shadowing: the lowest-priority occupant of a slot renders, so priority −10 replaces the stock browse dialog (registered at priority 0) in both entry points. The stock plugin stays loaded and untouched, and uninstalling this plugin restores it.

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · How it works：The listing itself reuses the host's existing `browse` capability over the client runtime (`ctx.workspaces.listDirectory` / `createDirectory`) — no host-side code, no filesystem access of its own.

```
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker/
├── package.json      # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client (dual-face declaration)
├── cordis.patch.yml  # loader-entry insertion
├── scripts/build.mjs # ESBuild: src/ → lib/

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · How it works：The browser half is written in TypeScript and compiled with ESBuild
(`npm run build`). Runtime imports (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, …) are external: they resolve
through the web shell's module table at load time, exactly like the official
client bundles. `npm run typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit`.

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` and later (web profile)
- Any host with mounted directories to reach: WSL (Windows drives appear under `/mnt`), macOS (external disks and disk images appear under `/Volumes`), or plain Linux with bind mounts under either root
- Locales: English, 简体中文 (follows your UI language)

dsh-wsl-workspace-picker README · Security & scope：Pure UI plugin. It adds no host-side behavior, opens no network connections, and only lists/creates directories through the same host `browse` capability the stock dialog already uses — with whatever file-sandbox policy your profile has in effect.
